blocks.zh: 附錄C/D及參考書目：印刷包材與驗證確效指引
blocks.en: Annexes C/D and Bibliography: Printed Packaging Materials and Validation Guidance

blocks.zh: Section Contents 本節內容
blocks.en: Section Contents

blocks.zh: Learning Objectives 學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 附錄C（規範性）：印刷初級包材的GMP要求 | p60-p63
blocks.en: Annex C (Normative): GMP Requirements for Printed Primary Packaging Materials | p60-p63

blocks.zh: 解說：為什麼附錄C特別重要？
blocks.en: Commentary: Why Is Annex C Especially Important?

blocks.zh: 規範性（Normative）= 強制性
blocks.en: Normative = Mandatory

blocks.zh: ISO標準中，附錄分為兩類：
blocks.en: In ISO standards, annexes fall into two categories:

blocks.zh: Normative（規範性）：與正文條款同等效力，必須遵守
blocks.en: Normative: carries the same weight as the clauses of the main text and must be complied with

blocks.zh: Informative（資訊性）：提供指導，非強制
blocks.en: Informative: provides guidance only and is not mandatory

blocks.zh: 附錄C是規範性的 — 所有製造印刷初級包材的組織均必須遵守。這與附錄D（資訊性的驗證指引）形成對比。
blocks.en: Annex C is normative, so every organization that manufactures printed primary packaging materials must comply with it. This contrasts with Annex D (informative validation guidance).

blocks.zh: 患者安全核心
blocks.en: Patient Safety at the Core

blocks.zh: 印刷包材上的文字直接影響患者用藥安全：錯誤的劑量說明、過期日期格式錯誤、或與其他產品混裝，都可能造成嚴重後果。附錄C的每項要求都指向同一個目標：確保「正確的標籤裝在正確的產品上」。
blocks.en: The text on printed packaging materials directly affects patient medication safety: wrong dosing instructions, an incorrect expiry date format, or mix-ups with other products can all cause serious harm. Every requirement in Annex C points to the same goal: ensuring that "the right label goes on the right product".

blocks.zh: 藝術稿件／原版與印刷壓印媒介的管控
blocks.en: Control of Artwork/Origination and Printing Media

blocks.zh: 解說：印版追溯鏈
blocks.en: Commentary: The Print Plate Traceability Chain

blocks.zh: 追溯鏈示意
blocks.en: Traceability Chain Overview

blocks.zh: ISO 15378要求從客戶主版到生產印版的完整追溯鏈：
blocks.en: ISO 15378 requires a complete traceability chain from the customer master to the production printing plate:

blocks.zh: 客戶核准原版 (Master Origination)
blocks.en: Customer-approved master origination

blocks.zh: ↓ 複製並驗證
blocks.en: ↓ Copy and verify

blocks.zh: 印版/印筒 (Print Plate/Cylinder)
blocks.en: Print plate/cylinder

blocks.zh: ↓ 唯一識別碼
blocks.en: ↓ Unique identifier

blocks.zh: 生產用印版（授權發出/回收）
blocks.en: Production plate (authorized issue/return)

blocks.zh: 每一層都必須文件化記錄，確保生產中使用的印版與客戶核准設計完全一致。
blocks.en: Every level must be documented to ensure that the plate used in production is identical to the design approved by the customer.

blocks.zh: 類比：銀行的簽章樣本管理
blocks.en: Analogy: Managing Bank Signature Specimens

blocks.zh: 就像銀行管理印章一樣：有「主印章」（客戶原版），開行後複製「作業印章」（生產印版）。每次借出/歸還都要登記，廢棄舊印章時要銷毀並記錄。印刷包材的印版管理邏輯完全相同。
blocks.en: It works like a bank managing seals: there is a "master seal" (the customer master), and "working seals" (production plates) are copied from it once the account is opened. Every loan and return is logged, and old seals are destroyed and recorded when retired. Print plate management for packaging materials follows exactly the same logic.

blocks.zh: 解說：多色印刷的套版控制
blocks.en: Commentary: Register Control in Multi-Colour Printing

blocks.zh: 多色印刷的風險
blocks.en: Risks of Multi-Colour Printing

blocks.zh: 藥品包材通常需要多色印刷（例如：黑色文字版、藍色色塊版、紅色警示版）。若某一色版遺失或使用錯誤版本，可能造成：
blocks.en: Pharmaceutical packaging materials usually need several colours (for example, a black text plate, a blue colour-block plate and a red warning plate). If one colour plate is missing or the wrong version is used, the result may be:

blocks.zh: 資訊缺失（如缺少劑量說明）
blocks.en: Missing information (such as absent dosing instructions)

blocks.zh: 顏色辨識錯誤（顏色是藥品識別的重要元素）
blocks.en: Colour identification errors (colour is an important element of medicinal product identification)

blocks.zh: 不同批次版本混用
blocks.en: Mixing of versions from different batches

blocks.zh: 因此，每套印版必須整組管理，確保「全套齊全」才能上機生產。
blocks.en: Each set of plates must therefore be managed as a complete set, and the full set must be present before it goes onto the press.

blocks.zh: 解說：版本變更的複雜性
blocks.en: Commentary: The Complexity of Version Changes

blocks.zh: 部分變更的挑戰
blocks.en: The Challenge of Partial Changes

blocks.zh: 設計變更時，不一定所有色版都需要更換。例如：只更新有效期格式（文字版變更），色塊版保持不變。此時需要：
blocks.en: A design change does not always require every colour plate to be replaced. For example, only the expiry date format (the text plate) may be updated while the colour-block plate stays the same. In this case you need to:

blocks.zh: 明確記錄哪些版更換、哪些保留
blocks.en: Record clearly which plates are replaced and which are retained

blocks.zh: 對舊版重新標識（避免誤用於新設計）
blocks.en: Re-identify the old plates (to avoid their misuse on the new design)

blocks.zh: 新舊版本不得在同一套版中混用
blocks.en: Never mix old and new versions within the same set of plates

blocks.zh: 解說：預防「舊版重出江湖」
blocks.en: Commentary: Preventing the Old Version from Coming Back

blocks.zh: 廢棄印版的風險
blocks.en: Risks of Obsolete Plates

blocks.zh: 如果廢棄的印版未被銷毀，可能被意外拿出使用，生產出帶有過期設計的包材。「渲染為不可用」（rendered unusable）是關鍵要求：
blocks.en: If an obsolete plate is not destroyed, it may be taken out and used by accident, producing packaging materials with an outdated design. "Rendered unusable" is the key requirement:

blocks.zh: 金屬版：物理毀形（彎折、穿孔）
blocks.en: Metal plates: physical destruction (bending, perforating)

blocks.zh: 電子檔：正式刪除並記錄
blocks.en: Electronic files: formal deletion with a record

blocks.zh: 感光底片：剪斷或化學處理
blocks.en: Photographic film: cutting or chemical treatment

blocks.zh: 隔離期間的版材必須有清楚的隔離標識，防止誤用。
blocks.en: Plates held in quarantine must carry clear quarantine identification to prevent misuse.

blocks.zh: 開機驗證（Make-Ready Verification）
blocks.en: Make-Ready Verification

blocks.zh: 每次開機前必須驗證印版設計是否正確。這不是一次性的事件 — 換版後、換班後、生產中斷復工後都需要重新確認。驗證結果必須記錄（7.5.3條款）。
blocks.en: The plate design must be verified as correct before every start-up. This is not a one-time event: it must be re-confirmed after a plate change, after a shift change and after a production interruption. The verification results must be recorded (clause 7.5.3).

blocks.zh: 印刷及轉換製程的GMP要求 | 開機準備、換版、留樣、幫派印刷
blocks.en: GMP Requirements for Printing and Converting Processes | Make-ready, plate changes, retained samples, gang printing

blocks.zh: 解說：開機準備廢料管理
blocks.en: Commentary: Managing Make-Ready Waste

blocks.zh: Make-Ready（試印）的目的
blocks.en: Purpose of Make-Ready (Trial Printing)

blocks.zh: 每次印刷機開機時，需要「試印」若干數量才能達到顏色穩定、套版精準。這些試印品（make-ready material）不能混入正式批次，必須：
blocks.en: Each time the press is started, a certain quantity must be run as "make-ready" before colour is stable and register is accurate. This make-ready material must not be mixed into the production batch. It must be:

blocks.zh: 明確標識為「廢料」
blocks.en: Clearly identified as "waste"

blocks.zh: 物理隔離存放
blocks.en: Physically segregated

blocks.zh: 作為生產廢棄物處置
blocks.en: Disposed of as production waste

blocks.zh: 前道工序（如印刷）的試印品可用於後道工序（如燙金、裁切）的試機，但同樣必須在後道工序結束後作廢料處置。
blocks.en: Make-ready material from an earlier operation (such as printing) may be used to set up a later operation (such as hot-foil stamping or cutting), but it must likewise be disposed of as waste once the later operation is finished.

blocks.zh: 解說：自動換版的風險
blocks.en: Commentary: Risks of Automatic Plate Changing

blocks.zh: 自動化 ≠ 免於GMP風險
blocks.en: Automation Does Not Remove GMP Risk

blocks.zh: 自動換版系統可以大幅縮短換版時間，但如果系統設計不允許進行「全線清場」（total line clearance），就必須：
blocks.en: Automatic plate-changing systems can greatly shorten changeover time, but if the system design does not allow a "total line clearance", the organization must:

blocks.zh: 進行文件化風險評估（documented risk assessment）
blocks.en: Perform a documented risk assessment

blocks.zh: 建立專項控制措施確保不發生產品混淆
blocks.en: Establish specific controls to ensure that no product mix-up occurs

blocks.zh: 確認前一工單的所有印版已從生產線移除
blocks.en: Confirm that all plates from the previous job have been removed from the production line

blocks.zh: 記錄所有控制措施的執行結果
blocks.en: Record the results of all control measures

blocks.zh: 關鍵原則：技術便利性不能以犧牲產品安全性為代價。風險評估是強制性的。
blocks.en: Key principle: technical convenience must not come at the expense of product safety. The risk assessment is mandatory.

blocks.zh: 解說：樣品的雙重管理
blocks.en: Commentary: Dual Management of Samples

blocks.zh: 兩類留樣，兩種處理
blocks.en: Two Types of Retained Samples, Two Treatments

blocks.zh: 「作廢」通常意味著在樣品上印上/蓋上「SAMPLE」或「VOID」字樣，使其無法被誤用為正式包材。這防止了樣品流入市場或被誤裝藥品。
blocks.en: "Voiding" usually means printing or stamping "SAMPLE" or "VOID" on the sample so that it cannot be mistaken for production packaging material. This prevents samples from reaching the market or being used to pack medicinal products by mistake.

blocks.zh: 解說：生產中換版的批次判定
blocks.en: Commentary: Batch Determination When Plates Are Changed During Production

blocks.zh: 兩種換版情境對比
blocks.en: Comparison of Two Plate Change Scenarios

blocks.zh: 邏輯：來源的可追溯性決定了批次的連續性。新來源意味著新的設計來源，必須重新驗證，因此必須開新批次。
blocks.en: Logic: traceability of the source determines the continuity of the batch. A new source means a new design origin, which must be re-verified, so a new batch must be opened.

blocks.zh: 解說：幫派印刷 — 效率與患者安全的衝突
blocks.en: Commentary: Gang Printing - Efficiency versus Patient Safety

blocks.zh: Gang Printing（幫派印刷）的嚴重風險
blocks.en: The Serious Risk of Gang Printing

blocks.zh: 「幫派印刷」是指在一次印刷作業中，在同一基材上同時印製多種不同設計。這在商業印刷中很常見（節省成本），但在藥品包材中是一個急性（acute）的混淆風險：
blocks.en: "Gang printing" means printing several different designs on the same substrate in a single print run. It is common in commercial printing (it saves cost), but for pharmaceutical packaging it is an acute mix-up risk:

blocks.zh: 不同設計之間的物理分隔不足
blocks.en: Insufficient physical separation between designs

blocks.zh: 裁切誤差可能導致設計A的部分進入設計B的批次
blocks.en: Cutting errors may carry part of design A into the batch of design B

blocks.zh: 「Admixture」（混入）= 一種產品的標籤混入另一種產品
blocks.en: "Admixture" = the labels of one product getting mixed into another product

blocks.zh: 類比：製藥中的「交叉污染」
blocks.en: Analogy: "Cross-Contamination" in Pharmaceutical Manufacturing

blocks.zh: 就像無菌製藥中，不同產品不能在同一條線上生產（除非有嚴格隔離和清場），幫派印刷把「不同藥品的識別信息」印在同一張紙上，其本質風險就是製藥中的「交叉污染（cross-contamination）」。標準明確稱之為「acute contributory risk」，措辭非常嚴厲。
blocks.en: Just as in sterile manufacturing different products must not be made on the same line (unless strict segregation and line clearance are in place), gang printing puts the identification information of different medicinal products on the same sheet, and its essential risk is the pharmaceutical equivalent of cross-contamination. The standard explicitly calls it an "acute contributory risk", which is very strong wording.

blocks.zh: 合規路徑：兩個必要條件缺一不可
blocks.en: Compliance Route: Both Conditions Are Required

blocks.zh: 客戶書面同意：不可只是口頭協議
blocks.en: Written customer agreement: a verbal agreement is not enough

blocks.zh: 文件化風險評估：必須評估具體的混淆風險並記錄緩解措施
blocks.en: Documented risk assessment: the specific mix-up risks must be assessed and the mitigation measures recorded

blocks.zh: 解說：庫存型生產的管控
blocks.en: Commentary: Control of Stock-Based Production

blocks.zh: Batched Production（批量生產備貨）
blocks.en: Batched Production (Production for Stock)

blocks.zh: 某些包材製造商會「預先生產」並在倉庫持有庫存，等待客戶下單後出貨。這種模式必須：
blocks.en: Some packaging material manufacturers "pre-produce" and hold stock in the warehouse, shipping it once the customer places an order. This model must:

blocks.zh: 有合約明確授權（contractually agreed）
blocks.en: Be contractually agreed

blocks.zh: 庫存管理系統確保追溯性（可追溯至製造批次和原料）
blocks.en: Have a stock management system that ensures traceability (to the manufacturing batch and the raw materials)

blocks.zh: 防止未授權的設計更改期間放行舊版庫存
blocks.en: Prevent the release of old-version stock during an unauthorized design change

blocks.zh: 庫存型模式的最大風險是：設計更改後，舊版庫存未被攔截就出貨給客戶。
blocks.en: The biggest risk of the stock-based model is that after a design change, old-version stock is not intercepted and is shipped to the customer.

blocks.zh: 數位印刷：新技術帶來的新管控要求 | p62
blocks.en: Digital Printing: New Technology Brings New Control Requirements | p62

blocks.zh: 解說：數位印刷 — 傳統印版管控的邊界失效
blocks.en: Commentary: Digital Printing - Where Traditional Plate Controls Break Down

blocks.zh: 數位印刷的獨特風險
blocks.en: Unique Risks of Digital Printing

blocks.zh: 傳統印刷靠「物理印版」作為防錯機制：錯誤的印版根本安不上機。但數位印刷完全依靠電腦文件，一個按鍵錯誤就可能把A產品的設計印在B產品的包材上，且外觀完全正常。
blocks.en: Traditional printing relies on the physical plate as an error-proofing mechanism: the wrong plate simply cannot be mounted on the press. Digital printing relies entirely on computer files, so a single keystroke error can print the design of product A on the packaging material of product B, with a perfectly normal appearance.

blocks.zh: 四大新增控制要求
blocks.en: Four Additional Control Requirements

blocks.zh: 安全文件訪問系統：防止操作人員意外選到錯誤的設計文件（如設置嚴格的文件權限、作業切換需要雙重確認）
blocks.en: Secure file access system: prevents operators from accidentally selecting the wrong design file (for example, strict file permissions and double confirmation for job changeover)

blocks.zh: 單一文件在記憶體：印刷機電腦在印刷過程中只能存有當前作業的文件，切換前必須清除
blocks.en: Single file in memory: the press computer may hold only the file of the current job during printing, and it must be cleared before switching

blocks.zh: 顏色設定正式化：數位印刷的顏色管理（色彩配置文件、ICC設定）需要通過正式流程建立並記錄，不能依賴操作人員的經驗調整
blocks.en: Formalized colour settings: colour management in digital printing (colour profiles, ICC settings) must be established through a formal process and recorded, and must not depend on the operator experience

blocks.zh: 產品分隔驗證：連續式卷材生產時，必須確認不同設計之間的間隔材料被正確識別並移除
blocks.en: Product separation verification: in continuous web production, it must be confirmed that the interval material between different designs is correctly identified and removed

blocks.zh: 類比：電子病歷的訪問控制
blocks.en: Analogy: Access Control for Electronic Medical Records

blocks.zh: 就像醫院的電子病歷系統必須確保醫生不會意外查看或修改錯誤患者的記錄，數位印刷系統必須確保操作人員不會意外載入錯誤產品的設計文件。兩者都是「信息系統的合規訪問控制」問題。
blocks.en: A hospital electronic medical record system must ensure that doctors do not accidentally view or modify the wrong patient record, and a digital printing system must likewise ensure that operators do not accidentally load the design file of the wrong product. Both are problems of "compliant access control for information systems".

blocks.zh: 安全碼系統、線上掃描驗證與卷材控制 | p62-p63
blocks.en: Security Code Systems, Online Scanning Verification and Web Control | p62-p63

blocks.zh: 解說：線上掃描的核心要求
blocks.en: Commentary: Core Requirements for Online Scanning

blocks.zh: 線上掃描 = 100%驗證
blocks.en: Online Scanning = 100% Verification

blocks.zh: 「每一個安全碼件均應由線上掃描設備驗證」—— 這是100%的線上確認，不是抽樣。對藥品包材的安全碼（如條碼、Data Matrix）來說，漏掉任何一個都可能意味著錯誤產品流出。
blocks.en: "Every security code item shall be verified by online scanning equipment." This is 100% online verification, not sampling. For security codes on pharmaceutical packaging materials (such as barcodes and Data Matrix), missing even one could mean that a wrong product leaves the plant.

blocks.zh: 挑戰測試（Challenge Test）的重要性
blocks.en: The Importance of Challenge Tests

blocks.zh: 掃描設備不只需要確認「能掃到碼」，還需要定期進行挑戰測試，確認：
blocks.en: Scanning equipment must not only confirm that it "can read the code"; it must also be challenge-tested periodically to confirm that it:

blocks.zh: 能偵測到錯誤的碼（不只是缺失的碼）
blocks.en: Detects incorrect codes (not just missing codes)

blocks.zh: 剔除機構確實動作，將不合格品排出
blocks.en: Has a reject mechanism that actually operates and removes nonconforming items

blocks.zh: 每次生產開始和定期間隔均執行，並記錄
blocks.en: Is tested at the start of each production run and at regular intervals, with the results recorded

blocks.zh: 類比：消防演習不只是確認警報響了，還要確認員工真的能撤離到安全地點。
blocks.en: Analogy: a fire drill does not just confirm that the alarm sounded; it also confirms that employees can really evacuate to a safe place.

blocks.zh: 掃描未執行的例外處理
blocks.en: Handling Exceptions When Scanning Is Not Performed

blocks.zh: 若規定要掃描但未執行，不能自動放行：
blocks.en: If scanning is required but was not performed, the material cannot be released automatically:

blocks.zh: 必須獲得正式授權（documented approval）
blocks.en: Formal authorization (documented approval) must be obtained

blocks.zh: 必須通知客戶並獲得書面同意
blocks.en: The customer must be notified and written agreement obtained

blocks.zh: 這是一個正式的偏差事件，需要記錄在品質記錄中
blocks.en: This is a formal deviation and must be recorded in the quality records

blocks.zh: 解說：卷材生產的特殊管控
blocks.en: Commentary: Special Controls for Web (Reel) Production

blocks.zh: 為什麼接縫（Splice）需要彩色膠帶？
blocks.en: Why Do Splices Need Coloured Tape?

blocks.zh: 卷材生產中，當一卷原材料用完需要接上新卷時，接縫處的包材可能存在印刷偏移、錯位等問題。使用鮮豔顏色的膠帶標記接縫，使客戶在後續灌裝操作中能快速辨識並排除這些位置的包材。
blocks.en: In web production, when one reel of raw material runs out and a new reel is spliced on, the packaging material at the splice may have printing shifts, misregistration and similar problems. Marking the splice with brightly coloured tape lets the customer quickly identify and remove the material at these positions during later filling operations.

blocks.zh: 卷芯追溯信息（C.3.4.3）
blocks.en: Reel Core Traceability Information (C.3.4.3)

blocks.zh: 批號、卷號、生產日期要記錄在卷芯內面（而非外面），原因是：
blocks.en: The batch number, reel number and production date are recorded on the inside of the reel core (not the outside), because:

blocks.zh: 外面的標籤容易在運輸中損壞或脫落
blocks.en: Labels on the outside are easily damaged or detached during transport

blocks.zh: 卷芯是整卷用完後仍保留的實物，追溯信息必須與其一起保留
blocks.en: The core is the physical item that remains after the whole reel is used up, so the traceability information must be kept with it

blocks.zh: 直到最後一圈材料用完，追溯鏈都保持完整
blocks.en: The traceability chain stays intact until the last turn of material is used

blocks.zh: 類比：「清場到素材」的邏輯
blocks.en: Analogy: The Logic of "Clearing Down to Plain Material"

blocks.zh: C.3.4.4要求生產結束時要「跑到素材（plain material）」才停機，就像廚房改換菜系前必須先清理鍋具一樣。印刷設備中殘留的印刷品如果進入下一個工單，就是「admixture（混入）」事件的源頭。
blocks.en: C.3.4.4 requires that, at the end of production, the line is run out to "plain material" before it stops, just as a kitchen must clean its pots before switching cuisines. Printed material left in the printing equipment, if it enters the next job, is the source of an "admixture" event.

blocks.zh: 缺印（Missing Print）的偵測系統
blocks.en: Detection Systems for Missing Print

blocks.zh: 部分印刷設備在特定條件下可能產生缺字、缺色的包材。如果這類包材流出，後果是患者拿到信息不完整的標籤。組織必須有系統性的偵測和剔除機制——不能依賴視覺檢查。
blocks.en: Under certain conditions, some printing equipment may produce packaging materials with missing characters or missing colours. If such material is released, patients end up with incomplete label information. The organization must have a systematic detection and rejection mechanism and must not rely on visual inspection.

blocks.zh: 附錄D（資訊性）：驗證、確認與驗證確效指引 | p64-p74
blocks.en: Annex D (Informative): Guidance on Verification, Qualification and Validation | p64-p74

blocks.zh: 解說：V/Q/V框架在包材製造中的意義
blocks.en: Commentary: What the V/Q/V Framework Means in Packaging Material Manufacturing

blocks.zh: 與EU GMP Annex 15的連結
blocks.en: Link to EU GMP Annex 15

blocks.zh: ISO 15378 Annex D的V/Q/V框架與EU GMP Annex 15（Qualification and Validation）高度平行。兩者都強調：
blocks.en: The V/Q/V (verification, qualification and validation) framework of ISO 15378 Annex D closely parallels EU GMP Annex 15 (Qualification and Validation). Both emphasize:

blocks.zh: 風險評估驅動決策
blocks.en: Risk assessment-driven decisions

blocks.zh: IQ → OQ → PQ的順序確認
blocks.en: Sequential confirmation through IQ → OQ → PQ

blocks.zh: 文件化的計劃、協議、報告結構
blocks.en: A documented plan, protocol and report structure

blocks.zh: 變更控制維持確認狀態
blocks.en: Change control to maintain the qualified state

blocks.zh: 熟悉EU GMP Annex 15的讀者在ISO 15378 Annex D中會找到相同的邏輯框架。
blocks.en: Readers familiar with EU GMP Annex 15 will find the same logical framework in ISO 15378 Annex D.

blocks.zh: 先決條件與考量因素：設備確認和製程驗證的前置要求
blocks.en: Prerequisites and Considerations: Preconditions for Equipment Qualification and Process Validation

blocks.zh: 解說：先決條件的邏輯順序
blocks.en: Commentary: The Logical Order of Prerequisites

blocks.zh: 先決條件的層次結構
blocks.en: Hierarchy of Prerequisites

blocks.zh:
先決條件準備
規格核准、角色確定、訓練完成
blocks.en:
Prerequisites in place
Specifications approved, roles defined, training completed

blocks.zh: ↓ 然後才能
blocks.en: ↓ Only then

blocks.zh:
設備驗證/確認（V/Q）
IQ → OQ → PQ
blocks.en:
Equipment verification/qualification (V/Q)
IQ → OQ → PQ

blocks.zh: ↓ 設備確認完成後
blocks.en: ↓ Once equipment qualification is complete

blocks.zh:
製程/產品驗證確效（Validation）
PV batches
blocks.en:
Process/product validation
PV batches

blocks.zh: 獨立性原則
blocks.en: The Principle of Independence

blocks.zh: 設備確認和製程驗證可以分開進行。這是一個重要的效率工具：
blocks.en: Equipment qualification and process validation can be performed separately. This is an important efficiency tool:

blocks.zh: 引入新產品時，已確認的設備不需要重新確認
blocks.en: When a new product is introduced, equipment that is already qualified does not need to be requalified

blocks.zh: 設備大修後，僅需重新做設備確認，現有產品的製程驗證可能仍然有效（需風險評估）
blocks.en: After a major equipment overhaul, only equipment requalification may be needed, and the existing process validation for current products may still be valid (subject to risk assessment)

blocks.zh: GAMP 5（附錄D.2.3的延伸）
blocks.en: GAMP 5 (an Extension of Annex D.2.3)

blocks.zh: GAMP 5（Good Automated Manufacturing Practice）是ISPE發布的電腦化系統合規指南。附錄D提到它作為軟體功能測試的指導，這也體現在參考書目[52]中。
blocks.en: GAMP 5 (Good Automated Manufacturing Practice) is the computerized system compliance guide published by ISPE. Annex D cites it as guidance for software functional testing, and this is also reflected in bibliography entry [52].

blocks.zh: 在包材製造中，軟體驗證範圍包括：印刷機PLC系統、視覺檢測系統、MES（製造執行系統）等。
blocks.en: In packaging material manufacturing, the scope of software validation includes press PLC systems, vision inspection systems, MES (manufacturing execution systems) and so on.

blocks.zh: 驗證主計劃：類型、角色與關鍵設備/製程判斷準則 | p65-p68
blocks.en: Validation Master Plan: Types, Roles and Criteria for Critical Equipment/Processes | p65-p68

blocks.zh: 解說：VMP是確認確效活動的「地圖」
blocks.en: Commentary: The VMP Is the "Map" of Qualification and Validation Activities

blocks.zh: VMP的功能定位
blocks.en: Positioning of the VMP

blocks.zh: VMP不是確認本身，而是確認活動的總體規劃文件。它回答三個問題：
blocks.en: The VMP is not the qualification itself; it is the overall planning document for qualification activities. It answers three questions:

blocks.zh: 做什麼？（哪些設備和製程需要確認）
blocks.en: What to do? (which equipment and processes need qualification)

blocks.zh: 怎麼做？（採用什麼方法和標準）
blocks.en: How to do it? (which methods and standards to apply)

blocks.zh: 誰來做？（角色和責任分配）
blocks.en: Who does it? (allocation of roles and responsibilities)

blocks.zh: 年度更新確保VMP反映最新的設備狀態、新引入的製程，以及任何已完成或計劃中的確認活動。
blocks.en: An annual update ensures that the VMP reflects the latest equipment status, newly introduced processes, and any completed or planned qualification activities.

blocks.zh: 解說：三種驗證確效方式的選擇邏輯
blocks.en: Commentary: Logic for Choosing Among the Three Validation Approaches

blocks.zh: 包材製造的特殊性：戰役性生產
blocks.en: A Special Feature of Packaging Material Manufacturing: Campaign Production

blocks.zh: 許多包材製造商採用「戰役性生產（campaign production）」模式——某個產品每季度或每半年生產一次大批量。在此情況下，並行驗證可能因為戰役結束而中斷，並在下次戰役開始時繼續。這是包材行業特有的靈活性，標準明確允許。
blocks.en: Many packaging material manufacturers use "campaign production": a given product is made in a large batch once a quarter or once every six months. In this case, concurrent validation may be interrupted when the campaign ends and resumed when the next campaign starts. This flexibility is specific to the packaging industry, and the standard explicitly allows it.

blocks.zh: 例外：滅菌製程必須使用前瞻性驗證
blocks.en: Exception: Sterilization Processes Must Use Prospective Validation

blocks.zh: 標準明確指出，這個「三種方式都可接受」的原則不適用於滅菌製程（見8.5.1.4.2和8.5.1.2.5）。滅菌製程必須使用前瞻性驗證——這也與FDA和EU GMP的立場一致。
blocks.en: The standard clearly states that this principle that "all three approaches are acceptable" does not apply to sterilization processes (see 8.5.1.4.2 and 8.5.1.2.5). Sterilization processes must use prospective validation, which is also consistent with the positions of the FDA and EU GMP.

blocks.zh: 解說：括號法/矩陣法的實務應用
blocks.en: Commentary: Practical Application of Bracketing/Matrix Approaches

blocks.zh: 這是製造商最有價值的工具之一
blocks.en: One of the Most Valuable Tools for Manufacturers

blocks.zh: 對於擁有多台相同型號設備的包材製造商，矩陣法可以大幅減少驗證工作量，同時保持合規性。關鍵前提是：必須先證明設備的等效性（equivalence）。
blocks.en: For packaging material manufacturers with several machines of the same model, the matrix approach can greatly reduce the validation workload while maintaining compliance. The key prerequisite is: the equivalence of the equipment must be demonstrated first.

blocks.zh: 實際計算：矩陣法節省的批次數
blocks.en: Worked Calculation: Batches Saved by the Matrix Approach

blocks.zh: 以Table D.1的3台等效機器為例：
blocks.en: Taking the three equivalent machines in Table D.1 as an example:

blocks.zh: 無矩陣法（傳統方式）：
blocks.en: Without the matrix approach (traditional method):

blocks.zh: 初次驗證：3台 × 3批 = 9批
blocks.en: Initial validation: 3 machines × 3 batches = 9 batches

blocks.zh: 年度重驗：3台 × 1批 × 每年 = 3批/年
blocks.en: Annual revalidation: 3 machines × 1 batch × every year = 3 batches/year

blocks.zh: 有矩陣法（Table D.1）：
blocks.en: With the matrix approach (Table D.1):

blocks.zh: 初次驗證：1台3批 + 2台1批 = 5批（節省44%）
blocks.en: Initial validation: 1 machine × 3 batches + 2 machines × 1 batch = 5 batches (44% saving)

blocks.zh: 年度重驗：每年1台 × 1批 = 1批/年（節省67%）
blocks.en: Annual revalidation: 1 machine per year × 1 batch = 1 batch/year (67% saving)

blocks.zh: 4年總計：無矩陣 = 9+12 = 21批；有矩陣 = 5+4 = 9批。節省57%的驗證批次。
blocks.en: Four-year total: without the matrix = 9+12 = 21 batches; with the matrix = 5+4 = 9 batches. A 57% saving in validation batches.

blocks.zh: 類比：藥廠的括號法驗證
blocks.en: Analogy: Bracketing Validation in a Pharmaceutical Plant

blocks.zh: 在製藥行業，括號法（bracketing）常用於穩定性研究——只測試最強和最弱規格的劑型，中間規格假設在範圍內。ISO 15378把相同邏輯應用到包材製程驗證，這是「基於科學和風險的法規思維」的典型應用。
blocks.en: In the pharmaceutical industry, bracketing is commonly used in stability studies: only the strongest and weakest strengths are tested, and the intermediate strengths are assumed to fall within the range. ISO 15378 applies the same logic to packaging material process validation, a typical example of "science- and risk-based regulatory thinking".

blocks.zh: 解說：確認前必須定義角色
blocks.en: Commentary: Roles Must Be Defined Before Qualification

blocks.zh: 解說：5個判斷關鍵設備的問題
blocks.en: Commentary: Five Questions for Identifying Critical Equipment

blocks.zh: GEP vs. 正式確認
blocks.en: GEP versus Formal Qualification

blocks.zh: 非關鍵設備不需要正式的IQ/OQ/PQ，但仍應遵循良好工程實踐（GEP）：
blocks.en: Non-critical equipment does not need formal IQ/OQ/PQ, but should still follow good engineering practice (GEP):

blocks.zh: 安裝和操作符合製造商規格
blocks.en: Installed and operated in accordance with manufacturer specifications

blocks.zh: 定期預防性維護
blocks.en: Regular preventive maintenance

blocks.zh: 校準（如適用）
blocks.en: Calibration (where applicable)

blocks.zh: 不需要書面確認方案/報告
blocks.en: No written qualification protocol/report required

blocks.zh: 「任何一個是=就是關鍵設備」
blocks.en: "Any one YES = critical equipment"

blocks.zh: 這6個問題是OR邏輯（任一為真則整體為真）。在包材製造中的實際應用：
blocks.en: These six questions use OR logic (if any one is true, the overall answer is true). Practical application in packaging material manufacturing:

blocks.zh:
Q1: 製程輸出是否可通過後續監測/量測來驗證？
Can the output be verified by subsequent monitoring or measurement?
blocks.en:
Q1: Can the process output be verified by subsequent monitoring/measurement?
Can the output be verified by subsequent monitoring or measurement?

blocks.zh: 是 (YES)
blocks.en: YES

blocks.zh:
Q2: 後續量測是否實際可行且具成本效益？
Is subsequent verification practical and cost-effective?
blocks.en:
Q2: Is subsequent measurement practical and cost-effective?
Is subsequent verification practical and cost-effective?

blocks.zh: 是
blocks.en: YES

blocks.zh:
非關鍵製程
不需要製程驗證確效
blocks.en:
Non-critical process
No process validation needed

blocks.zh: 否
blocks.en: NO

blocks.zh:
關鍵製程
需要製程驗證確效
blocks.en:
Critical process
Process validation needed

blocks.zh: 否 (NO)
blocks.en: NO

blocks.zh:
關鍵製程
必須進行製程驗證確效
blocks.en:
Critical process
Process validation must be performed

blocks.zh: 解說：製程驗證確效的觸發邏輯
blocks.en: Commentary: The Trigger Logic for Process Validation

blocks.zh: 核心原則：「事後無法量測=必須事前驗證」
blocks.en: Core Principle: "If It Cannot Be Measured Afterwards, It Must Be Validated Beforehand"

blocks.zh: 製程驗證確效的根本邏輯來自ICH Q10和EU GMP：如果一個製程的缺陷只有在產品使用後才會顯現（而不能通過成品檢驗偵測），那就必須通過驗證確效來保證製程的一致性。
blocks.en: The fundamental logic of process validation comes from ICH Q10 and EU GMP: if a process defect only becomes apparent after the product is used (and cannot be detected by finished product testing), the consistency of the process must be assured through validation.

blocks.zh: 確認確效的具體實施：IQ/OQ/PQ階段與製程驗證確效執行 | p68-p71
blocks.en: Practical Implementation of Qualification and Validation: IQ/OQ/PQ Stages and Process Validation Execution | p68-p71

blocks.zh: Risk Assessment 風險評估
blocks.en: Risk Assessment

blocks.zh:
Requirement Specifications 需求規格書
URS / Equipment Spec
blocks.en:
Requirement Specifications
URS / Equipment Spec

blocks.zh: IQ — Installation Qualification 安裝確認
blocks.en: IQ - Installation Qualification

blocks.zh: OQ — Operational Qualification 操作確認
blocks.en: OQ - Operational Qualification

blocks.zh: PQ — Performance Qualification 性能確認
blocks.en: PQ - Performance Qualification

blocks.zh: Release for Production 放行生產
blocks.en: Release for Production

blocks.zh: 解說：IQ/OQ/PQ三階段確認
blocks.en: Commentary: The Three Stages of IQ/OQ/PQ

blocks.zh: URS — 確認的起點
blocks.en: URS: The Starting Point of Qualification

blocks.zh: URS（使用者需求規格書）必須在採購設備前完成，它定義了：
blocks.en: The URS (user requirements specification) must be completed before the equipment is purchased. It defines:

blocks.zh: 設備必須生產的產品規格
blocks.en: The product specifications the equipment must produce

blocks.zh: 功能性要求（速度、精度等）
blocks.en: Functional requirements (speed, accuracy and so on)

blocks.zh: GMP相關要求（可清潔性、材質相容性）
blocks.en: GMP-related requirements (cleanability, material compatibility)

blocks.zh: 操作人員接觸/安全性要求
blocks.en: Operator access/safety requirements

blocks.zh: 空間佈局考量
blocks.en: Layout and space considerations

blocks.zh: URS是之後所有確認活動的基準文件。
blocks.en: The URS is the baseline document for all later qualification activities.

blocks.zh: 「數據借用（Leveraging）」原則
blocks.en: The Principle of "Leveraging" Data

blocks.zh: 若供應商工廠測試（FAT）已收集了充分數據，這些數據可以「搬運」到現場確認中使用，不需要重複收集。前提是：設備在運輸/安裝過程中沒有發生可能影響測試結果的事件。這是基於風險的務實做法，避免不必要的重複工作。
blocks.en: If factory acceptance testing (FAT) at the supplier has already collected sufficient data, that data can be "carried over" and used in on-site qualification without being collected again. The condition is that no event occurred during transport or installation that could affect the test results. This is a pragmatic, risk-based approach that avoids unnecessary duplication of work.

blocks.zh: 解說：PQ的靈活性
blocks.en: Commentary: Flexibility in PQ

blocks.zh: 「通常3批」不是鐵律
blocks.en: "Typically Three" Batches Is Not a Hard Rule

blocks.zh: 「Typically three」（通常3批）在GMP語境中是常見的基準，但ISO 15378明確提供了例外情況。對於需要數週才能完成一批的製程（例如大卷材的長時間印刷），可以用「最少一天的sub-batch」替代完整的3批。
blocks.en: "Typically three" batches is a common benchmark in the GMP context, but ISO 15378 explicitly provides exceptions. For processes that take several weeks to complete one batch (for example, long print runs of large reels), a "sub-batch of at least one day" can replace the full three batches.

blocks.zh: 這是科學性和務實性的平衡——確認原則不因生產週期長就被跳過，而是以等效的方式執行。
blocks.en: This balances science and pragmatism: the qualification principle is not skipped because the production cycle is long, but is carried out in an equivalent way.

blocks.zh: PQ可以與製程驗證合併
blocks.en: PQ Can Be Combined with Process Validation

blocks.zh: 基於風險管理，PQ可以：
blocks.en: Based on risk management, PQ can be:

blocks.zh: 跳過：若設備標準化程度高，OQ已足夠確認性能
blocks.en: Skipped: if the equipment is highly standardized and OQ is sufficient to confirm performance

blocks.zh: 與PV合併：PQ批次同時作為製程驗證批次，一舉兩得
blocks.en: Combined with PV: the PQ batches also serve as process validation batches, achieving both at once

blocks.zh: 決定跳過或合併需要有風險評估支持和品質部門批准。
blocks.en: The decision to skip or combine must be supported by a risk assessment and approved by the quality unit.

blocks.zh: 解說：製程驗證 vs. 產品驗證
blocks.en: Commentary: Process Validation versus Product Validation

blocks.zh: 關鍵區別：製程驗證獨立於產品
blocks.en: Key Difference: Process Validation Is Independent of the Product

blocks.zh: 製程驗證（Process Validation）是驗證「製程本身」的能力，與具體產品無關。例如：
blocks.en: Process validation verifies the capability of the "process itself" and is independent of any specific product. For example:

blocks.zh: 驗證「輪轉凹版印刷製程」能穩定達到特定色彩精度和套印誤差
blocks.en: Validating that the "rotogravure printing process" consistently achieves a given colour accuracy and register tolerance

blocks.zh: 一旦製程驗證完成，新產品在此製程上生產時，通常只需要產品確認，而不需要重新驗證製程
blocks.en: Once process validation is complete, a new product made on this process usually needs only product qualification, not revalidation of the process

blocks.zh: 產品驗證（Product Validation）是在製程驗證基礎上，加入特定客戶或產品的要求（如特定油墨相容性、特殊基材）。
blocks.en: Product validation adds the requirements of a specific customer or product (such as specific ink compatibility or special substrates) on top of process validation.

blocks.zh: 確認確效的文件層次結構：計劃→協議→報告→VSR | p71-p74
blocks.en: Document Hierarchy for Qualification and Validation: Plan → Protocol → Report → VSR | p71-p74

blocks.zh: 解說：V/Q/V文件的金字塔結構
blocks.en: Commentary: The Pyramid Structure of V/Q/V Documents

blocks.zh: 文件層次（Figure D.3 邏輯結構）
blocks.en: Document Hierarchy (Logical Structure of Figure D.3)

blocks.zh:
VMP 驗證主計劃
整體策略與計劃
blocks.en:
VMP (Validation Master Plan)
Overall strategy and planning

blocks.zh: ↓ 拆解為各項目
blocks.en: ↓ Broken down into individual items

blocks.zh:
Plan 計劃書（可選）
單一設備/製程的確認計劃
blocks.en:
Plan (optional)
Qualification plan for a single piece of equipment/process

blocks.zh: ↓ 詳細化
blocks.en: ↓ Detailed in

blocks.zh:
Protocol 協議/方案書
具體測試步驟和驗收標準
blocks.en:
Protocol
Specific test steps and acceptance criteria

blocks.zh: ↓ 執行後產生
blocks.en: ↓ Execution produces

blocks.zh:
Report 報告
實際測試結果、偏差、結論
blocks.en:
Report
Actual test results, deviations, conclusions

blocks.zh: ↓ 所有階段完成
blocks.en: ↓ When all stages are complete

blocks.zh:
VSR 驗證總結報告（可選）
整個項目的正式結案
blocks.en:
VSR (Validation Summary Report, optional)
Formal closure of the whole project

blocks.zh: Protocol vs. Report 的核心差異
blocks.en: Core Difference between Protocol and Report

blocks.zh:
協議（Protocol）必須在執行前核准——它定義「我們計劃怎麼做」。
報告（Report）在執行後撰寫——它記錄「我們實際做了什麼以及結果如何」。
blocks.en:
The protocol must be approved before execution: it defines "how we plan to do it".
The report is written after execution: it records "what we actually did and what the results were".

blocks.zh: 這個「先核准協議，再執行，再報告」的順序是GMP的基本原則——確保測試前已明確定義驗收標準，防止「事後更改標準」的行為。
blocks.en: This sequence of "approve the protocol, then execute, then report" is a basic GMP principle. It ensures that acceptance criteria are clearly defined before testing and prevents the practice of "changing the criteria after the fact".

blocks.zh: 類比：醫療試驗的預先申報
blocks.en: Analogy: Pre-Registration of Clinical Trials

blocks.zh: 臨床試驗也要求在試驗前預先申報方案（研究方案），結果的統計方法和成功標準必須事先定義。確認確效的協議先行原則出自同樣的科學誠信邏輯。
blocks.en: Clinical trials also require the protocol to be registered in advance, and the statistical methods and success criteria for the results must be defined beforehand. The protocol-first principle in qualification and validation comes from the same logic of scientific integrity.

blocks.zh: 偏差的處理原則
blocks.en: Principles for Handling Deviations

blocks.zh: 報告中記錄的偏差不一定意味著確認失敗。關鍵是：
blocks.en: A deviation recorded in the report does not necessarily mean that the qualification has failed. The key points are:

blocks.zh: 每個偏差必須有書面的根本原因分析
blocks.en: Every deviation must have a written root cause analysis

blocks.zh: 對產品質量影響必須評估
blocks.en: The impact on product quality must be assessed

blocks.zh: 糾正措施必須文件化並追蹤完成
blocks.en: Corrective actions must be documented and tracked to completion

blocks.zh: 品質部門必須批准「帶偏差放行」
blocks.en: The quality unit must approve any "release with deviations"

blocks.zh: 確認確效的維護：變更控制、預防性維護與重新確認 | p74
blocks.en: Maintaining Qualification and Validation: Change Control, Preventive Maintenance and Requalification | p74

blocks.zh: 解說：確認確效不是一次性活動
blocks.en: Commentary: Qualification and Validation Is Not a One-Time Activity

blocks.zh: 「控制狀態」= 不需要重新確認的前提
blocks.en: "State of Control" = Precondition for Not Needing Requalification

blocks.zh: ISO 15378 Annex D的立場與ICH Q10一致：若設備/製程在控制狀態下穩定運行，不需要週期性重新確認（除了潔淨室、滅菌製程等特殊情況）。
blocks.en: The position of ISO 15378 Annex D is consistent with ICH Q10: if equipment/processes run stably in a state of control, periodic requalification is not needed (except in special cases such as cleanrooms and sterilization processes).

blocks.zh: 如何判斷「控制狀態」：
blocks.en: How to judge the "state of control":

blocks.zh: 日常製程控制數據符合規格
blocks.en: Routine process control data meet specifications

blocks.zh: 產品測試數據無統計趨勢
blocks.en: Product test data show no statistical trends

blocks.zh: 無重大偏差或客訴
blocks.en: No significant deviations or complaints

blocks.zh: 無設備或製程變更
blocks.en: No changes to equipment or process

blocks.zh: 變更控制 = 確認狀態的守門員
blocks.en: Change Control = Gatekeeper of the Qualified State

blocks.zh: 確認確效完成後，變更控制系統成為保護確認狀態的核心機制：
blocks.en: Once qualification and validation are complete, the change control system becomes the core mechanism protecting the qualified state:

blocks.zh: 任何對已確認設備/製程的變更必須通過正式變更控制
blocks.en: Any change to qualified equipment/processes must go through formal change control

blocks.zh: 變更風險評估需評估對確認狀態的影響
blocks.en: The change risk assessment must evaluate the impact on the qualified state

blocks.zh: 重大變更（如設備大修、製程參數調整）可能觸發重新確認
blocks.en: Major changes (such as equipment overhaul or process parameter adjustment) may trigger requalification

blocks.zh: 變更控制需要貫穿設備/製程的整個生命週期
blocks.en: Change control must run through the whole lifecycle of the equipment/process

blocks.zh: 類比：汽車的定期保養
blocks.en: Analogy: Regular Car Servicing

blocks.zh: 預防性維護計劃（D.6.4）就像汽車的定期保養——不是等車壞了才修，而是按照製造商的建議定期維護，確保設備始終在設計性能範圍內運作。校準也是其中的一部分：測量儀器必須定期校準，確保「設備說合格，確實是合格」。
blocks.en: The preventive maintenance programme (D.6.4) is like regular car servicing: you do not wait for the car to break down before repairing it, but maintain it at regular intervals as the manufacturer recommends, so that the equipment always operates within its designed performance range. Calibration is part of this too: measuring instruments must be calibrated regularly, so that when the equipment says "pass", it really is a pass.

blocks.zh: 參考書目：ISO 15378:2017所引用的標準與指引 | p75-p77
blocks.en: Bibliography: Standards and Guidelines Cited in ISO 15378:2017 | p75-p77

blocks.zh: 解說：參考標準的體系地圖
blocks.en: Commentary: A Map of the Reference Standards System

blocks.zh: ICH Q9 + ICH Q10的重要性
blocks.en: The Importance of ICH Q9 and ICH Q10

blocks.zh: ISO 15378在Annex D中多次隱含地引用ICH Q9（風險管理）和ICH Q10（藥品質量體系）的原則。明確引用[54][55]表明標準作者有意將包材製造商的GMP要求與藥品製造商的最佳實踐對齊。
blocks.en: Annex D of ISO 15378 repeatedly and implicitly draws on the principles of ICH Q9 (risk management) and ICH Q10 (pharmaceutical quality system). The explicit citation of [54] and [55] shows that the authors of the standard intentionally align the GMP requirements for packaging material manufacturers with the best practices of medicinal product manufacturers.

blocks.zh: 這對包材製造商的含義是：理解ICH Q9的風險評估工具（FMEA、HACCP、FTA等）能幫助更好地執行ISO 15378的要求。
blocks.en: The implication for packaging material manufacturers is that understanding the ICH Q9 risk assessment tools (FMEA, HACCP, FTA and so on) helps them implement the requirements of ISO 15378 better.

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 15主要針對藥品製造商（成品廠）。ISO 15378 Annex D把同樣的V/Q/V框架應用到包材製造商，並加入了包材行業特有的考量（如戰役性生產、矩陣法）。兩者可以相互參照——理解一個有助於理解另一個。
blocks.en: EU GMP Annex 15 is aimed mainly at medicinal product manufacturers (finished product plants). ISO 15378 Annex D applies the same V/Q/V framework to packaging material manufacturers and adds considerations specific to the packaging industry (such as campaign production and the matrix approach). The two can be cross-referenced: understanding one helps in understanding the other.

blocks.zh: ISO 15378的標準引用邏輯
blocks.en: The Logic of Standards Citation in ISO 15378

blocks.zh: ISO 15378引用了大量外部標準，它們各自提供不同層面的指導：
blocks.en: ISO 15378 cites a large number of external standards, each providing guidance at a different level:

blocks.zh: 定義術語字母索引：ISO 15378:2017全文使用的術語 | p78-p79
blocks.en: Alphabetical Index of Defined Terms: Terms Used Throughout ISO 15378:2017 | p78-p79

blocks.zh: 解說：術語索引的使用指南
blocks.en: Commentary: How to Use the Terminology Index

blocks.zh: 術語索引的實務用途
blocks.en: Practical Uses of the Terminology Index

blocks.zh: ISO 15378的術語章節（第3條款）定義了本標準所有特定術語的確切含義。在審計、合規評估或合約談判中，當術語有爭議時，應回到第3條款的定義確認含義。
blocks.en: The terminology clause of ISO 15378 (clause 3) defines the exact meaning of all the specific terms in the standard. In audits, compliance assessments or contract negotiations, when a term is disputed, go back to the definition in clause 3 to confirm its meaning.

blocks.en: Term Groups That Need Special Attention

blocks.en: Qualification and validation terms:

blocks.en: Batch management terms:

blocks.zh: 環境控制術語組：
blocks.en: Environmental control terms:

blocks.zh: 「Quality Critical」(3.11.1) 的核心地位
blocks.en: The Central Role of "Quality Critical" (3.11.1)

blocks.zh: 「quality critical（品質關鍵）」是整個ISO 15378風險管理框架的核心判斷點。設備（D.3.4）、製程（D.3.5）、參數，都需要先判斷是否「quality critical」，再決定需要什麼等級的確認確效控制。這個術語在整個標準中出現的頻率反映了它的重要性。
blocks.en: "Quality critical" is the core decision point of the whole ISO 15378 risk management framework. Equipment (D.3.4), processes (D.3.5) and parameters must first be judged as to whether they are "quality critical", and only then is the level of qualification and validation control determined. The frequency with which this term appears throughout the standard reflects its importance.
